02 / BACKEND + DATA MODELING CASE STUDY

FluxKart.

An Express backend for reconciling fragmented customer identifiers into a deterministic contact graph.

FluxKart Customer Identity Resolver is a TypeScript Node.js backend service for reconciling customer records that arrive with overlapping email addresses and phone numbers. Its focused POST /identify endpoint validates incoming data with Zod, then applies deterministic contact-linking rules through Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. The implementation keeps the oldest related record as the primary contact and represents newer linked records as secondary contacts. It also handles the harder case where a new request connects previously separate primary clusters. The repository separates routes, controllers, services, validation, utilities, and database access, making the business logic inspectable. Vitest tests use mocked Prisma interactions to exercise resolver scenarios and edge cases.

TypeScript Node.js Express 5 PostgreSQL Prisma Zod Vitest
THE PROBLEM

Identity needs
correctness.

When a customer appears under overlapping email and phone combinations, the service resolves associated contacts while retaining the oldest contact as primary and newer linked contacts as secondary.

API DESIGN

One focused endpoint

POST /identify accepts email and/or phone number and returns a normalized primary ID, ordered identifiers, and secondary contact IDs.

VALIDATION

Input before logic

Zod validation ensures at least one identifier is supplied before resolution runs.

DATA REASONING

Merge clusters

The identified service handles linking connected contacts and merging disjoint primary clusters when a request connects them.

VERIFICATION

Edge cases matter

Vitest tests with mocked Prisma interactions cover resolver behavior. Prisma schema and Render configuration are included in the repository.

REQUEST FLOW

Deterministic
resolution.

POST /identify ↓ Zod request validation ↓ Find contacts connected by supplied email / phone ↓ Preserve chronological primary; link secondary contacts ↓ Return normalized identity cluster
